f.title: Use e-Reporting Industria only for new cases; close cases started by e-mail through e-mail
f.statement: Individual case reports are notified to e-Reporting Industria only for new cases and their follow-ups. If an initial case and follow-ups were notified through the previous e-mail mechanism, follow-up and closure of that case must be done through the same route, by e-mail.

f.title: Literature reports: choose the report type, give the bibliographic reference, never use "not available to sender"
f.statement: For literature notifications, choose Spontaneous report or Study report according to the origin of the case, and add the bibliographic reference in the Bibliographic references field, which is mandatory for literature reports. If the origin of the literature report is unclear, choose "other"; the option "not available to sender" must not be used.

f.statement: The WWUID consists of the country initials (UY), the company short name, which must be established with the Unit and not modified afterwards, and the number identifying the report.

f.title: Do not modify the constant part of WWUID/SRUID; use a unique consecutive number of at least 5 digits
f.statement: The constant section of both identifiers cannot be modified once defined with the Unit; another internal laboratory ID or specific notification codes requested by the Unit go in the field Other case identifiers in previous transmissions. The constant section is predefined when a report is entered and must not be modified. The variable section of the WWUID and SRUID must be a consecutive number of at least 5 digits, unique for each case, so the first report entered in the manual module must be 00001.
f.clause: 3.9.1 Módulo de ingreso manual — Identificadores

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder in Uruguay (Laboratorio Titular de Registro, LTR) reporting to the MSP Pharmacovigilance Unit
rows.quote: La sección constante de ambos identificadores una vez que ya se han definido con la UFV, no podrá ser modificada posteriormente. Si requiere utilizar otro ID interno del laboratorio o códigos de notificaciones específicos solicitados por la UFV, agréguelo en el campo Other case identifiers in previous transmissions. Cuando ingresa un reporte al sistema, la sección constante de ambos identificadores ya viene predefinida, por lo que no es necesario ni debe modificar estos IDs. La sección variable del WWUID y SRUID debe constar de un número consecutivo de al menos 5 dígitos el cual debe ser único para cada caso. Por lo que el primer reporte que ingrese en el módulo de carga manual debe ser el 00001.

f.title: Do not send notifications lacking the four fundamental criteria
f.statement: A notification that does not have at least the 4 fundamental criteria (information quality grade 0) must not be sent; the missing information must be sought in order to report the case.

f.title: For a follow-up, update the fields, the most recent information date and the narrative, then send and download the XML
f.statement: Follow-up information or changes must be added in the corresponding fields, and the Date of most recent information must be updated to the date the follow-up was received. The case narrative must also be updated with the new information, below a line and labelled Seguimiento 1, Seguimiento 2 as applicable. After capturing the follow-up, the report must be sent and the corresponding XML file downloaded; without that file no later follow-up is possible.

rows.quote: Debe agregar la nueva información o modificaciones respectivas del seguimiento en los campos correspondientes, entre ellas es fundamental actualizar la Fecha de información más reciente que corresponde a la fecha cuando recibió el seguimiento. Es importante que, en el seguimiento, además de agregar la nueva información en los campos específicos, también actualice el caso narrativo con la nueva información. Para separar la información de la inicial o los seguimientos anteriores, utilice una línea y coloque la nueva información debajo, agregando el texto: Seguimiento 1, Seguimiento 2, según corresponda. Caso Narrativo Una vez que haya concluido la captura de información de seguimiento, debe enviar el reporte y descargar el archivo XML correspondiente. Recuerde que, si no descarga el archivo, no podrá realizar el seguimiento posterior.
rows.location: 3.9.1 Módulo de ingreso manual — Reporte de seguimiento
rows.review_note: Review: "debe" and "es fundamental" read as Mandatory; "es importante" (narrative update) is included in the same duty. Re-translation agrees. Double-check: added in pass 3; the line "Caso Narrativo" is a figure caption inside the quoted span.

Remember that if you do not download the file, you will not be able to carry out the later follow-up.

f.title: Download the ackLog promptly after each XML upload and keep backups of it
f.statement: The ackLog must be downloaded as soon as possible after uploading the XML, since the system keeps only the previous 35 days of history and it cannot be downloaded after that. The sender is responsible for keeping backups of the ackLogs generated, since the Unit cannot regenerate an ackLog once it is deleted from the history.
f.clause: 3.10 Módulo CARGAR E2B (Importante)

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder in Uruguay (Laboratorio Titular de Registro, LTR) reporting to the MSP Pharmacovigilance Unit
rows.deadline: As soon as possible after upload (history kept 35 days)
rows.quote: Es fundamental que descargue el acklog lo más pronto posible una vez cargado el XML, ya que el sistema solo podrá guardar el histórico de 35 días previos. Una vez pasado este límite, ya no podrá descargar el acklog. Es responsabilidad del emisor tener respaldo de los acklog generados, ya que la UFV no podrá generar nuevamente acklog una vez que se eliminen del histórico .
rows.location: 3.10 Módulo CARGAR E2B (Importante)

Once this limit is passed, you will no longer be able to download the acklog. f.title: Report ADRs, ESAVI, medication errors and other safety problems for pharmaceutical specialties
f.statement: Events to be notified: ADRs and ESAVI in which the medicine is suspected of being involved (there must always be at least one suspect medicine); medication errors whether or not the incident reached the patient (incidents with no potential patient identified must not be notified this way); other safety problems: medication error, overdose, misuse, off-label use, exposure in pregnancy and/or lactation, suspected lack of efficacy. Only notifications on pharmaceutical specialties are received; other products are excluded.
f.clause: 4.4 Anexo D — Eventos que deben ser notificados
f.exceptions: Medication-error incidents with no potential patient identified are not notified by this route; products other than pharmaceutical specialties are excluded.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder in Uruguay (Laboratorio Titular de Registro, LTR) reporting to the MSP Pharmacovigilance Unit
rows.quote: Eventos que deben ser notificados: o RAM y ESAVI presentados por el paciente en los que hay sospechas de que el medicamento estuvo implicado en el evento que se informa. Siempre tiene que haber por lo menos un medicamento sospechoso. o Errores de Medicación en los cuales el incidente haya llegado o no al paciente. Aquellos incidentes en los cuales no hay un paciente potencial identificado, no deben ser notificados por esta vía. Otros problemas de seguridad: error de medicación, sobredosis, mal uso, uso fuera de indicación, exposición en el embarazo y/o lactancia, sospecha de falta de eficacia. Aclaración: Sólo se recibirán notificaciones relacionadas con especialidades farmacéuticas. Se excluyen los productos no comprendidos en esta categoría.
rows.location: 4.4 Anexo D — Eventos que deben ser notificados
rows.review_note: Review: quote verified verbatim; level follows the Spanish modal. Re-translation agrees with quote_en. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: Events that must be notified: o ADRs and ESAVI presented by the patient in which the medicine is suspected of being involved in the reported event. There must always be at least one suspect medicine. o Medication errors in which the incident did or did not reach the patient. Incidents with no potential patient identified must not be notified through this route. Other safety problems: medication error, overdose, misuse, off-label use, exposure in pregnancy and/or lactation, suspected lack of efficacy. Clarification: Only notifications related to pharmaceutical specialties will be received. Products not in this category are excluded.

f.title: Report a new event in the same patient as a new notification; do not report unrelated follow-up
f.statement: Follow-up is any complementary information on the event(s) initially reported. Follow-up on the patient's disease not linked to the notified events must not be reported. If the same patient has a new event, possibly related to the same or another medicine, a new notification must be entered.
f.clause: 4.4 Anexo D — Seguimientos

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder in Uruguay (Laboratorio Titular de Registro, LTR) reporting to the MSP Pharmacovigilance Unit
rows.quote: Seguimientos: Se considera seguimiento, toda información complementaria relacionada con el o los eventos reportados inicialmente. Aclaraciones: o Los seguimientos relacionados con la patología del paciente y no vinculados a los eventos notificados, no deben ser reportados. o Si el mismo paciente presenta un nuevo evento, posiblemente relacionado con el mismo medicamento o con otro, se deberá ingresar una nueva notificación.
rows.location: 4.4 Anexo D — Seguimientos
rows.review_note: Review: quote verified verbatim; level follows the Spanish modal. Re-translation agrees with quote_en. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: Follow-ups: Follow-up is any complementary information related to the event(s) initially reported. Clarifications: o Follow-ups related to the patient's disease and not linked to the notified events must not be reported. o If the same patient presents a new event, possibly related to the same medicine or another, a new notification shall be entered.

f.title: Report domestic cases only, except medicines bought in Uruguay with the event abroad
f.statement: The tool is for adverse events occurring in Uruguay, except where a patient/consumer buys a medicine in Uruguay and the event/reaction occurs in another country.
f.clause: 4.5 Anexo E (Preguntas frecuentes) — casos fuera de Uruguay

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder in Uruguay (Laboratorio Titular de Registro, LTR) reporting to the MSP Pharmacovigilance Unit
rows.quote:
La herramienta está dirigida a la notificación de Eventos Adversas a
Medicamentos ocurridas a nivel Nacional, excepto en aquellas ocasiones en que
un paciente/consumidor adquiere un medicamento en Uruguay y el
evento/reacción sucede en otro país.
rows.location: 4.5 Anexo E (Preguntas frecuentes) — casos fuera de Uruguay
rows.review_note: Review: FAQ answer; recorded as Mandatory scope rule with lower confidence. Re-translation agrees. Double-check: statement matches the quote; kept below 90 because the wording is descriptive.
rows.quote_en: The tool is intended for notification of Adverse Drug Events occurring nationally, except where a patient/consumer acquires a medicine in Uruguay and the event/reaction occurs in another country.

f.title: Report cases from post-marketing studies, spontaneous reports and literature
f.statement: Reportable sources are post-marketing clinical studies, spontaneous reports and literature reports.
f.clause: 4.5 Anexo E (Preguntas frecuentes) — reportes objeto de notificación

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder in Uruguay (Laboratorio Titular de Registro, LTR) reporting to the MSP Pharmacovigilance Unit
rows.quote:
Aplica para estudios clínicos post comercialización, reportes espontáneos y
reportes de la literatura.
rows.location: 4.5 Anexo E (Preguntas frecuentes) — reportes objeto de notificación
rows.review_note: Review: FAQ scope answer with no modal; recorded as Mandatory scope. Re-translation agrees. Double-check: statement matches the quote; kept below 90.
rows.quote_en: It applies to post-marketing clinical studies, spontaneous reports and literature reports.

f.title: Report a case once the four minimum criteria are collected
f.statement: For a report to be valid it must have at least an identifiable primary source (reporter to the LTR), an identifiable patient (initials, age or age band), a medicine and an adverse event. A case without these 4 minimum criteria cannot be notified; once the minimum information is collected, the notification must be made.
f.clause: 4.5 Anexo E (Preguntas frecuentes) — criterios mínimos

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder in Uruguay (Laboratorio Titular de Registro, LTR) reporting to the MSP Pharmacovigilance Unit
rows.quote: Para que un reporte sea considerado como válido es necesario tener al menos la siguiente información: Fuente primaria identificable (Notificador al LTR), Paciente identificable (Iniciales, edad o franja etaria) Medicamento y Evento Adverso. ¿Puedo notificar un caso que no tenga los 4 criterios mínimos? No. Una vez recabada la información mínima necesaria (referida en la pregunta anterior), se deberá realizar la notificación.
rows.location: 4.5 Anexo E (Preguntas frecuentes) — criterios mínimos
rows.review_note: Review: "se deberá realizar la notificación" read as Mandatory. Re-translation agrees. Double-check: added in pass 3; statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: For a report to be considered valid it must have at least the following information: identifiable primary source (reporter to the LTR), identifiable patient (initials, age or age band), medicine and adverse event. Can I notify a case that does not have the 4 minimum criteria? No. Once the minimum necessary information (referred to in the previous question) has been collected, the notification must be made.

f.title: A PV representative of several companies must notify the Unit of each company it represents
f.statement: A laboratory that is the pharmacovigilance representative of more than one company must notify the Unit of the information of each company it represents, including the company name and identifiers. Representing a laboratory's products differs from buying the licence of some of its products; in those cases the Unit must be consulted.
f.clause: 4.5 Anexo E (Preguntas frecuentes) — representante de más de una empresa

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder in Uruguay (Laboratorio Titular de Registro, LTR) reporting to the MSP Pharmacovigilance Unit
rows.quote: En este caso, deberán notificar a la UFV, la información de cada una de las empresas a las cuales representa, tomando en cuenta la razón social y los identificadores. Hay que tener en cuenta que es diferente representar los productos de un laboratorio a comprar la licencia de algunos productos de un laboratorio. En estos casos, consultar a la UFV.
rows.location: 4.5 Anexo E (Preguntas frecuentes) — representante de más de una empresa
rows.review_note: Review: "deberán notificar" read as Mandatory; "consultar a la UFV" is an imperative in the same answer. Re-translation agrees. Double-check: added in pass 3; statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: In this case, they must notify the UFV of the information of each of the companies they represent, taking into account the company name and the identifiers. Bear in mind that representing the products of a laboratory is different from buying the licence for some products of a laboratory. In these cases, consult the UFV.

f.title: Enter the reported term verbatim and always code the reaction/event to MedDRA
f.statement: In the Reaction/event as reported field the term is entered literally as given by the primary source; the MedDRA term (PT level) is used in the structured Reaction/event field. The evaluator must always code the reaction/event term supplied by the primary source to the corresponding MedDRA term.
f.clause: 4.5 Anexo E (Preguntas frecuentes) — codificación MedDRA

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder in Uruguay (Laboratorio Titular de Registro, LTR) reporting to the MSP Pharmacovigilance Unit
rows.quote: Si, en el campo Reacción/evento tal cual fue reportado por la fuente primaria, se coloca el término de forma literal, tal como lo indica la fuente primaria. El término MedDRA (Nivel PT), se utiliza en el campo estructurado de Reacción/evento. El evaluador deberá codificar siempre el término de la reacción/ evento suministrada/o por la fuente primaria al término MedDRA correspondiente.
rows.location: 4.5 Anexo E (Preguntas frecuentes) — codificación MedDRA
rows.review_note: Review: quote verified verbatim; level follows the Spanish modal. Re-translation agrees with quote_en. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: Yes, in the Reaction/event as reported by the primary source field, the term is entered literally, as the primary source states it. The MedDRA term (PT level) is used in the structured Reaction/event field. The evaluator shall always code the reaction/event term supplied by the primary source to the corresponding MedDRA term.

f.title: Assess causality for each ME/ADR/ESAVI, for suspect medicines only
f.statement: The causality assessment must be made for each medication error, ADR or ESAVI, and applies only to the suspect medicine(s).
f.clause: 4.5 Anexo E (Preguntas frecuentes) — causalidad por PT

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder in Uruguay (Laboratorio Titular de Registro, LTR) reporting to the MSP Pharmacovigilance Unit
rows.quote: La evaluación de causalidad se debe realizar para cada EM/RAM/ESAVI, solo es aplicable para el (los) medicamento sospechoso.
rows.location: 4.5 Anexo E (Preguntas frecuentes) — causalidad por PT
rows.review_note: Review: "se debe" read as Mandatory. Re-translation agrees. Double-check: added in pass 3; statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: The causality assessment must be made for each ME/ADR/ESAVI; it applies only to the suspect medicine(s).

f.title: Keep a backup of notified cases; the platform is not a case database
f.statement: e-Reporting Industria does not work as a case database; the marketing authorisation holder (LTR) must keep a backup of the notified cases.
f.clause: 4.5 Anexo E (Preguntas frecuentes) — casos cargados anteriormente

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder in Uruguay (Laboratorio Titular de Registro, LTR) reporting to the MSP Pharmacovigilance Unit
rows.quote: El e-reporting industria no funciona como una base de datos de los casos, el LTR deberá tener respaldo de los casos notificados.
rows.location: 4.5 Anexo E (Preguntas frecuentes) — casos cargados anteriormente
rows.review_note: Review: quote verified verbatim; level follows the Spanish modal. Re-translation agrees with quote_en. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: e-Reporting Industria does not work as a database of cases; the LTR must keep a backup of the notified cases.

f.title: Include a causality assessment for every drug-reaction pair in all reports
f.statement: All reports must include a causality assessment, made per medicine-reaction pair, so there are as many assessments as reactions per suspect medicine.
f.clause: 4.5 Anexo E (Preguntas frecuentes) — evaluación de causalidad

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder in Uruguay (Laboratorio Titular de Registro, LTR) reporting to the MSP Pharmacovigilance Unit
rows.quote:
Sí, es necesario que todos los reportes incluyan su debida evaluación de
causalidad. Se debe recordar que la evaluación se realiza por el par
“medicamento-reacción” por lo que se realizaran tantas evaluaciones como
reacciones por medicamento sospechoso existan.
rows.location: 4.5 Anexo E (Preguntas frecuentes) — evaluación de causalidad
rows.review_note: Review: quote verified verbatim; level follows the Spanish modal. Re-translation agrees with quote_en. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: Yes, all reports must include their proper causality assessment. Remember that the assessment is made per "medicine-reaction" pair, so there will be as many assessments as reactions per suspect medicine.

f.title: Do not use the ackLog for E2B follow-ups; keep WWUID, short name and Sender ID identical
f.statement: The ackLog must not be used for a follow-up sent by E2B transmission, since it is only the electronic acknowledgement. Follow-ups of initial cases entered in the manual module may be uploaded by XML-E2B; it is important to ensure from the start that the WWUID, short name and Sender ID are exactly the same, so that VigiFlow recognises the report as a follow-up.
f.clause: 4.5 Anexo E (Preguntas frecuentes) — seguimiento de carga manual a E2B

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder in Uruguay (Laboratorio Titular de Registro, LTR) reporting to the MSP Pharmacovigilance Unit
rows.quote: No, no se debe utilizar el acklog. Debe recordar que el acklog solo es el acuse de recepción electrónico. Por otro lado, los seguimientos de casos iniciales ingresados en carga manual si pueden ser cargados vía XML-E2B, lo importante es asegurarse desde el inicio que el WWUID, el nombre corto y el Sender ID sean exactamente los mismos, para que al entrar el reporte a VigiFlow lo reconozca como seguimiento, de ahí la importancia de tener los datos de la compañía correctos.
rows.location: 4.5 Anexo E (Preguntas frecuentes) — seguimiento de carga manual a E2B
rows.review_note: Review: the ackLog prohibition is Mandatory ("no se debe"); the XML-E2B route is permitted and the identifier match is framed as important. Re-translation agrees. Double-check: added in pass 3; kept below 90 because the row mixes levels.
rows.quote_en: No, the acklog must not be used. Remember that the acklog is only the electronic acknowledgement of receipt. On the other hand, follow-ups of initial cases entered in manual upload can be uploaded via XML-E2B; the important thing is to make sure from the start that the WWUID, the short name and the Sender ID are exactly the same, so that when the report enters VigiFlow it is recognised as a follow-up; hence the importance of having the company data correct.

f.title: Download and save the report XML immediately on sending
f.statement: A report that was not downloaded cannot be downloaded later, so it is mandatory to download and save it immediately when the report is sent.
f.clause: 4.5 Anexo E (Preguntas frecuentes) — descarga del reporte
f.processes: Data integrity & records; Case processing & follow-up

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder in Uruguay (Laboratorio Titular de Registro, LTR) reporting to the MSP Pharmacovigilance Unit
rows.quote: Si no descargué el reporte, ¿ya no es posible descargarlo? No, por ello es obligatorio descargarlo y guardarlo inmediatamente que se envía el reporte.
rows.location: 4.5 Anexo E (Preguntas frecuentes) — descarga del reporte
rows.review_note: Review: quote verified verbatim; level follows the Spanish modal. Re-translation agrees with quote_en. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: If I did not download the report, is it no longer possible to download it? No; therefore it is mandatory to download and save it immediately when the report is sent.

f.title: During outages wait 3 hours; report outages over 24 hours to the Unit
f.statement: When UMC carries out updates, access may be intermittent for a few hours; the user must wait at least 3 hours and try again. If e-Reporting Industria cannot be accessed for more than 24 hours for a cause not attributable to UMC (which may be documented with a screenshot if internal procedure requires it), the error is to be reported to the MSP Pharmacovigilance Unit and the service monitored until restored.
f.clause: 4.5 Anexo E (Preguntas frecuentes) — contingencia

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder in Uruguay (Laboratorio Titular de Registro, LTR) reporting to the MSP Pharmacovigilance Unit
rows.quote: Cuando el UMC realiza actualizaciones, no tarda más que unas horas en concluirlas por lo que el acceso puede ser intermitente para algunos usuarios. En este caso debe esperar al menos 3 horas y volver a intentar el acceso. En caso de que no pueda acceder a e-Reporting Industria por más de 24 horas y que se deba a una causa ajena al UMC (puede documentarlo con captura de pantalla si su procedimiento interno lo solicita),
rows.location: 4.5 Anexo E (Preguntas frecuentes) — contingencia
rows.review_note: Review: "debe esperar" read as Mandatory; the instruction to report the error and monitor follows the Unit contact e-mail address, which cannot be quoted, so the quote stops before it. Re-translation agrees. Double-check: kept below 90 because the reporting step is outside the quote.
rows.quote_en: When UMC carries out updates, it takes no more than a few hours to complete them, so access may be intermittent for some users. In this case you must wait at least 3 hours and try accessing again. If you cannot access e-Reporting Industria for more than 24 hours and this is due to a cause not attributable to UMC (you may document it with a screenshot if your internal procedure requires it),

f.title: Confirm the ackLog shows AA (accepted); load again on AE or AR
f.statement: When downloading the ackLog XML, confirm it contains <acknowledgement typeCode="AA"> (Application Acknowledgement Accept), which confirms successful transmission. If an ackLog shows AE (Application Acknowledgment Error) or AR (Application Acknowledgment Reject), the information must be loaded again.
f.clause: 4.5 Anexo E (Preguntas frecuentes) — acklog

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder in Uruguay (Laboratorio Titular de Registro, LTR) reporting to the MSP Pharmacovigilance Unit
rows.quote: Al descargar el xml es necesario confirmar que el siguiente dato se encuentre contenido, pues confirma la transmisión exitosa de la información: <acknowledgement typeCode="AA"> AA – Application Acknowledgement Accept (message successfully processed, no further action) En caso de recibir un acklog con alguna de las siguientes codificaciones, será necesario cargar la información: AE – Application Acknowledgment Error (error detected, error response has additional detail, some ICSR message(s) need further action) 82 AR – Application Acknowledgment Reject (parsing error, no data extracted, resend the entire transaction)
rows.location: 4.5 Anexo E (Preguntas frecuentes) — acklog
rows.review_note: Review: "es necesario" read as Mandatory; quote extended over the AE/AR codes (includes the page number 82). Re-translation agrees. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: When downloading the xml it is necessary to confirm that the following data is contained, since it confirms the successful transmission of the information: <acknowledgement typeCode="AA"> AA – Application Acknowledgement Accept (message successfully processed, no further action) If you receive an acklog with any of the following codes, it will be necessary to load the information: AE – Application Acknowledgment Error (error detected, error response has additional detail, some ICSR message(s) need further action) 82 AR – Application Acknowledgment Reject (parsing error, no data extracted, resend the entire transaction)

f.title: Provide the long name, short name and sender identifier and keep them the same for manual and XML modules
f.statement: The long name, short name and sender identifier must be provided, even if work starts in the manual module; they must be the same as those first given for the manual module and those used to generate XML-E2B, to avoid problems receiving cases in the XML module.
f.clause: 4.5 Anexo E (Preguntas frecuentes) — nombre corto

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder in Uruguay (Laboratorio Titular de Registro, LTR) reporting to the MSP Pharmacovigilance Unit
rows.quote: Si, debe proporcionarse el nombre largo, el nombre corto y el sender identifier. Estos datos deben ser los mismos que se proporcionen inicialmente para el módulo de carga manual y los que se usen para generar XML-E2B. Esto evitará que haya problemas futuros en la recepción de casos en el módulo de carga de XML.
rows.location: 4.5 Anexo E (Preguntas frecuentes) — nombre corto
rows.review_note: Review: "debe" and "deben" read as Mandatory. Re-translation agrees. Double-check: added in pass 3; statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: Yes, the long name, the short name and the sender identifier must be provided. These data must be the same as those initially provided for the manual upload module and those used to generate XML-E2B. This will avoid future problems in receiving cases in the XML upload module.

f.title: Use standardised causality assessment methods as a priority
f.statement: Priority use of standardised causality assessment methods is requested.
f.clause: 4.5 Anexo E (Preguntas frecuentes) — método de causalidad

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder in Uruguay (Laboratorio Titular de Registro, LTR) reporting to the MSP Pharmacovigilance Unit
rows.quote: Se solicita la utilización prioritaria de metodologías de evaluación estandarizadas.
rows.location: 4.5 Anexo E (Preguntas frecuentes) — método de causalidad
rows.review_note: Review: "se solicita ... prioritaria" read as Recommended. Re-translation agrees. Double-check: added in pass 3; kept below 90 because "se solicita" could also be read as a requirement.
rows.quote_en: Priority use of standardised assessment methodologies is requested.

dates.title: Valid MedDRA and WHODrug licences required for e-Reporting Industria (Uruguay)
dates.scope: Pharmaceutical industry reporting through e-Reporting Industria, manual and XML upload modules
dates.quote:
Es requisito contar con licencias MedDRA y
    WHODrug vigentes a partir del 13/07/2025 de acuerdo a la Ordenanza Nº
    23/025.
dates.quote_en: It is a requirement to hold valid MedDRA and WHODrug licences from 13/07/2025 in accordance with Ordinance No. 23/025.
dates.location: 4.4 Anexo D — Licencias MedDRA y WHODrug

dates.title: E2B(R3) format required for e-Reporting Industria (Uruguay)
dates.scope: Pharmaceutical industry reporting through e-Reporting Industria
dates.quote:
Es requisito utilizar el formato E2B R3 para la utilización
    de la herramienta a partir del 13/07/2025 de acuerdo a la Ordenanza Nº
    23/025.
dates.quote_en: It is a requirement to use the E2B R3 format to use the tool from 13/07/2025 in accordance with Ordinance No. 23/025.
